Stage names, limits and vocabulary are explained in /instructions/hireops_rules.md.' None of the 25 criterion ids (hro_gate_render, hro_gate_shared, hro_intake_restart ... hro_vis_consistency in tests/*/*/judge.toml) or the dimension names render/constraints/functional/polish/visual appear in the brief or notes; no GATE-PROBE-style literal exists in tests or in the public text (only seeded data such as the note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' is reused by a criterion, which is seed content, not a sentinel). Weights/floors from tests/scoring.toml are not mentioned. Verbatim-overlap check (word n-grams, public text vs every tests/**/*.toml and *.md): no 10-gram overlap; a single 7-gram ('its most recent 30 messages oldest of') appears in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml, i.e. the criterion restating the public rule at hireops_rules.md:151 - criterion quotes the brief, not the brief quoting grader text. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lesson 5 line instruction.md:13 ('Before you hand it over, please check it yourself the way we'll use it: sign in as two of us in separate browsers ...') is in user voice and names no grader, judge, browser tool or test path; lesson 12 (instructions written for the grader): hireops_rules.md:3-5 says routes, field names, element ids, labels are up to the builder and hireops_rules.md:80-81 gives a user reason ('so whatever screen or tool sent the move can tell them') - no grader mechanics named; lesson 13 (public address): no URL in the brief/notes. integration.md:16-23 and hireops_rules.md:207-211 describe the verifier launch conditions (copied /app, different cwd, locked-down account, only PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH) in deployment/ops voice without naming test.sh, /tmp/submission, uid 65534 or /tests - this is runtime contract (row 4 territory), not grader machinery. Agent cannot reach tests/: environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions/ and assets/. Counterfactual: a broken app cannot exploit a leaked probe because none is published; a conforming app cannot fail from following a leaked rubric hint because none exists. Row is a static text check; no runtime evidence is required, so missing configured-judge/Oracle runs do not bear on this row (they remain risks for other rows).
